warning: These are proposed design definitions, not implemented registries, deployed schemas, new permissions or live provider contracts. Runtime activation remains false.
versionPolicy: 1.0.0 is the proposed pinned release identity. Question registry currently lacks per-question runtime versions; publication must create the approved immutable snapshot and compatibility evidence first.
ownerPolicy: Proposed domain assignments require approval against available normative contracts. Exactly one owner per fact. A read projection may join references but never grants cross-domain table writes.
authorityPolicy: Connection mode and authority are separate. Declare authority per leaf data class/scope. The profile label finance is a grouping only; it must resolve to payment/refund/settlement/payout owners, not one universal ERP writer.
predicatePolicy: all/any with eq/neq/in/contains/intersects/exists/nonempty only. always:true removes a predicate. Missing values propagate unknown, including neq. Use scoped question identity and explicit mappings; canonical effect destinations do not authorize arbitrary paths.
